answer: The canyon test I would run is Signed croquet club membership with tournament entries: tournaments entered for five years, so each new name must bring its own proof instead of reusing a sibling's. A farm that reuses one proof across ten accounts is caught at the second account, because tournaments entered for five years is bound to a single identity — the prism is that reuse itself becomes the evidence. Running a hundred clones would mean a hundred separate proofs, each costing real money and real time, and the river of that bill is larger than anything one epoch pays out.
